_source: Natural Earth 1:10m admin-1 states and provinces, the version with the large lakes cut out, 5.1.1 (ne_10m_admin_1_states_provinces_lakes, public domain, naturalearthdata.com): the sixteen states of Germany by their iso_3166_2 field, and the countries around - their regions dissolved - as the land around, clipped to the box. Simplified with mapshaper 0.6.121 (weighted Visvalingam, the topology kept, so neighbours share their border, and no region lost) for a picture 1000 high, and 300 for a small one. Codes and names: ISO 3166-2:DE, the English names those of the holidays subsystem, the German beside them.
_projection: Lambert azimuthal equal-area centred on 51.15 N 10.45 E (GRS80); metres scaled so the longer side of the box is 1000 units, y downwards, rounded
_format: regions: ISO 3166-2 code => [ the code without its country, name, other names, [ x0, y0, x1, y1 ], path, path simplified for a small map ] - paths in relative coordinates of whole units, y downwards, a region too small to keep its outline a diamond of 3 units round its middle, one without an outline in this view an empty path; _box: the box the view shows; context: the land around the regions, the same, under ~ and its ISO alpha-3 code, drawn without values
